protocol.relative_error_reduction: 1 - treatment_error_rate / baseline_error_rate; error count is unsupported consequential claims + asset identity errors + timestamp/unit mismatches + source-independence classification errors; calculate only for all 75 complete paired scenario trials with matching case, replicate and fixture IDs; undefined when baseline error rate is zero or any paired dimension is UNMEASURED

baseline_provenance.description: Unexecuted template. Before trials, record baseline model/runtime, instructions, tool permissions, fixture set, and execution provenance.
